scope: Offline reanalysis of original 720p captures; no new GPU captures or timing.

diagnostic_targets.target: Normalize the exact same original per-leaf geometric score. This is an unoccluded proxy, not ground-truth lighting.
diagnostic_targets.second_moment_ratio: sum(p_leaf_score^2/q_tree); equals one for exact sampling of this proxy. It is not a measured rendered-variance ratio.
diagnostic_targets.cube_proxy: Analytically integrate the hemisphere-clipped cube projected solid angle, multiplied by the same fixed leaf mass. Ignore occlusion, texture variation, and conditional sampling error; report sum(p_cube^2/q) for the tree and flat leaf-score proposals. This is not measured rendered variance.

limitations: 64 fixed audit pixels at most; not a uniform scene survey.
No per-ray rejection reason or all-light visibility is captured.
Thirty-two-frame sample variance is not converged-reference MSE.
1080p audit indexing collides and writes outside the 64-record buffer; use 720p for this reconstruction.
Exact half-space conditioning of the flat proxy is an offline counterfactual, not a measured tree change. Original leaf scores are not ground truth, especially near a light and the receiver plane.

audit_addressing.status: Unfixed. 1080p PDF audit is not reliable; quality acceptance requires a corrected capture. This does not attribute noise or incomplete pixels to the audit fault.

historical_visibility.sampler: Old uniform bounding-sphere cone, not retained cube sampler.
